name: Pellotine
summary: Pellotine, also known as peyotline or N-methylanhalonidine, is a tetrahydroisoquinoline alkaloid found in Lophophora species, in particular Lophophora diffusa (false peyote) and to a much lesser extent Lophophora williamsii (peyote). It produces sedative and hypnotic effects and may contribute to the non-hallucinogenic effects of peyote.
